name: Angler Fiona

intro.text: Powan, perch, pike, brown trout. Loch Lomond has a powan too, a fish that has been here since the ice age. I've caught none of them.

win: I'll say this for you, you're quicker than any powan.
after: The powan is a freshwater whitefish stranded here after the last ice age. It's rare, so mind where you stand.
